text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Kh... my legs can't take any more...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Is this as far as we go...?
For today, at least...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Victoire Pisa isn't extending!
Rulership is done for as well!

An inadequate finish has its limits after all.
Rulership couldn't win, and Victoire Pisa couldn't pull off the victory either.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, it really isn't so easy, is it?
Still, Pisa, to think even you would sink...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: This is what makes gaming so fun.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I... suppose you're right... I didn't run the way I wanted to. But...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I managed to connect things to what comes next.
All to weave a grand circle at the 'Japan Derby.'"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, true enough. Today was only mid-adjustment.
For both me and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The Nippon Derby is indeed
the final round for this generation. Who will reign supreme—
I wonder who it'll be, Pisa?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, have we secured a foothold
to build the Kingdom of Roses, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—33.0 seconds.
Just a bit more—until I break through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, after running against them, I felt it clearly...
every single camp is undeniably a powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: "Flash-senpai, at this rate, the Japan Derby will likely turn into a fierce battle the likes of which history has rarely seen."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it will be a battle where
a delay of even 0.01 seconds could prove fatal.

Everyone was already looking ahead to the next one.
No—

Even before the race, everyone might have already
been looking toward what comes next.
Even so—
choice_data_list: This year... the field is insanely stacked...

text_block_list.text:
The level of the other runners besides the favorites is remarkably high too.
Years with a Classic Triple Crown this heated don't come around very often.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Man, I can't wait! On top of today's top runners, if new Umamusume join in too—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With such a star-studded lineup,
this year's Japan Derby will undoubtedly—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's the greatest Derby in history!
That night—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today's race made it crystal clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Just focusing on the start and setting the pace nicely isn't enough to win the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of Umamusume who excel at the gates.
Even if I were to cover that area...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My start will only ever be "average."
I can't close the gap, and in the end, it won't be enough.
That is why—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We need a strategy. Something outside of the start
that will overwhelmingly surpass the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for a session, Trainer.
We're going to come up with a game-changing strategy no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A winning move that will decide everything.
Our "Japanese Derby" has already begun.

The two of us racked our brains.
Even as the moon set and the sun rose,
our strategy meeting continued endlessly.
